title: GRUMMAN FLXIBLE CORP.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:STARTER SOLENOID (227 affected)
summary: THE AIR STARTER CONTROL VALVE IS EQUIPPED WITH A MANUAL OVERRIDE PUSH-BUTTON WHICH BYPASSES THE NORMAL NEUTRAL SAFETY INTERLOCK AND IS NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 102, "TRANSMISSION SHIFT LEVER SEQUENCE, STARTER INTERLOCK, AND TRANSMISSION BRAKING EFFECT".

title: Volvo Trucks North America: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT HUB (300 affected)
summary: FRONT HUBS WERE MACHINED IMPROPERLY AND COULD SPLIT OR BREAK AT THE WHEEL MOUNTING FLANGE. THE WHEEL MOUNTING FLANGE HOLDS THE WHEEL AND BRAKE DRUM SYSTEM TOGETHER. WHEEL AND BRAKE DRUM COULD SEPARATE FROM VEHICLE.

title: ALCOA AL. CO. OF AMER.: WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS (36,000 affected)
summary: SOME TWO-PIECE WHEEL CAP NUTS HAVE A FAULTY WASHER SECTION THAT CANNOT BE DETECTED BY THE NAKED EYE. THIS DEFECT MAY LEAD TO CRACKING OF THE WASHER SECTION WHICH CAN CAUSE NUT TO LOOSEN. EVENTUALLY, THE NUTS COULD FALL OFF AND THE WHEEL WOULD BECOME DETACHED FROM THE VEHICLE.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS (261,400 affected)
summary: SEAT FRAME STRUCTURE COULD SEVER FRONT SEAT BELTS IF VEHICLE IS INVOLVED IN AN ACCIDENT, DEPENDING ON FORCE OF IMPACT.

title: Ford Motor Company: STEERING:LINKAGES:ROD:RELAY:CONNECTING (495 affected)
summary: IF THE SELECTOR IS GENTLY OR SLOWLY MOVED TOWARDS PARK, THE TRANSMISSION MAY NOT CHANGE TO PARKING GEAR. SIMILARLY, SLOW MOVEMENT OF THE SELECTOR FROM REVERSE TO NEUTRAL MAY NOT REMOVE THE TRANSMISSION FROM REVERSE GEAR.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:LUBRICANT:TRANSMISSION:MANUAL (35,919 affected)
summary: REAR WHEELS MAY LOCK SUDDENLY DUE TO INSUFFICIENT LUBRICATION BETWEEN MAINSHAFT AND FIRST GEAR.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:FRONT:UNDERHOOD (300 affected)
summary: DURING A FULL TURN OF THE STEERING WHEEL, THE FRONT LEFT SPRINGS MAY DAMAGE THE BRAKE SYSTEM OR THE ELECTRICAL SYSTEM.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:TRUCK:CAB:LATCHES (44 affected)
summary: IMPROPER REAR CAB LATCH MAY NOT LATCH PROPERLY CAUSING INADEQUATE CAB-TO-FRAME ATTACHMENT AT THE REAR CAB.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:PEDALS:LINKAGES AND VALVES (196 affected)
summary: CONTROL VALVES MAY NOT ALLOW FULL PRESSURE RELEASE AFTER BRAKE PEDAL HAS BEEN RELEASED BY OPERATOR.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: STEERING:LINKAGES:TIE ROD:END (44 affected)
summary: THE TIE ROD END ATTACHES TO THE STEERING LINKAGE WITH A STUD WHICH MAY CRACK AND BREAK.

title: Ford Motor Company: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN (810,000 affected)
summary: BLADES MAY CRACK AND MAY, OVER A PERIOD OF TIME, LOOSEN FROM FAN ASSEMBLY.
